IRON YARD — one-time owner-authorized PUBLIC release, 12 November 2026.

through the existing fail-closed CI-gated workflow. No private/alpha target.
Source PR #41 is merged at 2d99fe8499542ba882b9cf0d0e0c2753d240a9ec.
It adds a bounded local-only opt-in owner/Studio weapon-swap microprofiler:
cached A/B model reuse vs full rebuild vs LOD rebuild vs initial equip;
mean, rolling last-48-sample P95, cached part count and total client RAM.
The prior owner-only weapon render CPU and FX diagnostic functionality
remains intact. The swap profiler runs ONLY when PERF is enabled, performs
no per-frame measurement, and transmits no timing or RAM data to a server.
Do not alter game authority, hit registration, ammo, damage, approved
PBR mesh trust, or published creator and experience IDs.
PR/branch CI and merged main CI passed. Require fresh exact-release-commit
Rojo CI success and independent public-owner destination verification.
Do not claim Android device FPS/memory improvements until measured.
